# anecdotes_requirement_view (Resource)

Manages an Anecdotes Requirement View: a requirement scoped beneath another ("parent")
requirement, letting the same underlying requirement content apply per control or
framework without duplicating it.

## Relationships

```
Requirement (anecdotes_requirement, the parent)
    │
    └── Requirement View (this resource)
            │
            └── linked to a control via anecdotes_mapping_control_requirement
```

## Key Concept: Parent-Inherited Fields

On creation, a view inherits its description, related evidences/policies, and scoping
overrides from its parent — those are not settable on the view itself. `category`
and `owners` are independent of the parent, exactly like on `anecdotes_requirement`.

## Immutability

`parent_id` cannot change after creation; changing it in configuration replaces
the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anecdotes_requirement" "acceptable_use_policy" {
  name        = "Acceptable use policy"
  description = "Defines the acceptable use of organizational assets"
  category    = "Access"
}

# A view is a requirement scoped beneath a parent — it inherits the parent's
# description, related evidences/policies, and scoping overrides on creation.
# Link it to a control with anecdotes_mapping_control_requirement just like
# any other requirement.
resource "anecdotes_requirement_view" "acceptable_use_policy_soc2" {
  parent_id = anecdotes_requirement.acceptable_use_policy.requirement_id
  view_name = "Acceptable use policy — SOC 2 scope"
  owners    = ["security@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_id` (String) The ID of the parent requirement this view is scoped beneath. Immutable after creation.
- `view_name` (String) The human-readable name of the requirement view. This is displayed as the view's title.

### Optional

- `category` (String) The category this requirement view belongs to. One of the categories Anecdotes defines; views that do not fit one of them belong under `Custom Requirements`, which is also the default. Removing the attribute restores the default.
- `owners` (Set of String) Email addresses of users responsible for this requirement view. Order does not matter. Terraform owns this attribute: removing it clears the owners.

### Read-Only

- `requirement_id` (String) The unique identifier of the requirement view in Anecdotes (e.g., `requirement_9012`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a requirement view by its requirement_id.
terraform import anecdotes_requirement_view.example requirement_12345
```
